query: How long is the probation period for a new employee?
anchors: probation period of six months
answer: Six months from the date of joining, extendable once by a further three months.

query: At what rate does earned leave accrue?
anchors: one and a half days for every completed calendar month
answer: One and a half days per completed calendar month, giving eighteen days in a full leave year.

query: What is the maximum earned leave I can carry forward to the next year?
anchors: forty five days of accumulated earned leave
answer: Forty five days; any balance above that lapses on 31 March and is not encashable.

query: How many casual leave days do I get and can they be carried forward?
anchors: Casual leave is granted at twelve days per leave year
answer: Twelve days per leave year, credited on 1 April; casual leave cannot be carried forward or encashed.

query: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
anchors: medical certificate from a registered practitioner
answer: When sick leave exceeds two consecutive working days.

query: What is the maximum sick leave that can be accumulated?
anchors: ceiling of sixty days
answer: Sixty days; accumulated sick leave is never encashable.

query: How much paid maternity leave is available for a first child?
anchors: twenty six weeks of paid maternity leave
answer: Twenty six weeks for the first two surviving children, twelve weeks thereafter.

query: How many days of paternity leave are granted and by when must they be taken?
anchors: fifteen days of paid paternity leave
answer: Fifteen days, to be availed within six months of the date of birth.

query: What are the core hours during which I must be reachable?
anchors: 11:00 to 16:00 India Standard Time
answer: 11:00 to 16:00 India Standard Time.

query: How many days a month can I work remotely without extra approval?
anchors: up to eight days in a calendar month
answer: Up to eight days per calendar month with the reporting manager's prior approval.

query: What happens if I get three late marks in one month?
anchors: Three late marks in a calendar month
answer: Three late marks in a calendar month are treated as one day of casual leave.

query: After how many days of unauthorised absence is service treated as abandoned?
anchors: exceeding eight consecutive working days is treated as voluntary abandonment
answer: More than eight consecutive working days of unauthorised absence.

query: How many public holidays does the company observe?
anchors: ten public holidays in a calendar year
answer: Ten, of which three are fixed nationally and seven are declared per office.

query: What is the daily allowance for travel to a metro city?
anchors: eighteen hundred rupees per day in a metropolitan city
answer: Eighteen hundred rupees per day in a metropolitan city, twelve hundred elsewhere.

query: What is the hotel ceiling per night in a metro city?
anchors: six thousand rupees per night in a metropolitan city
answer: Six thousand rupees per night in a metropolitan city, four thousand elsewhere.

query: If I stay with relatives instead of a hotel, what can I claim?
anchors: one thousand rupees per night is payable in lieu
answer: A lump sum of one thousand rupees per night in lieu of a hotel bill.

query: What is the deadline for submitting a travel reimbursement claim?
anchors: within thirty days of the completion of travel
answer: Thirty days from completion of travel; up to sixty days with written justification; never after sixty days.

query: Can a reimbursement claim be paid seventy days after the trip?
anchors: after sixty days is not payable
answer: No. A claim submitted after sixty days is not payable under any circumstance.

query: What is the annual professional development allowance?
anchors: twenty five thousand rupees per financial year
answer: Twenty five thousand rupees per financial year, non carry-forward.

query: Is there a service commitment for a company sponsored certification?
anchors: service commitment of twelve months
answer: Yes, twelve months from the date of certification where the sponsorship exceeds fifty thousand rupees.

query: How do I escalate a grievance if my manager does not resolve it?
anchors: escalated in writing to the Head of Human Resources
answer: After ten working days without resolution, escalate in writing to the Head of Human Resources, who responds within fifteen working days.

query: How long do I have to respond to a show cause notice?
anchors: seven days to respond
answer: Seven days.

query: What is the estimated value of the solid waste tender?
anchors: forty two crore rupees for the three year period
answer: Forty two crore rupees for three years.

query: How much is the earnest money deposit?
anchors: earnest money deposit is eighty four lakh rupees
answer: Eighty four lakh rupees, two percent of the estimated contract value.

query: What is the last date and time for submitting the online bid?
anchors: 2 September 2024 up to 17:30 hours
answer: 2 September 2024 up to 17:30 hours.

query: What average annual turnover must a bidder have?
anchors: average annual turnover of not less than fourteen crore rupees
answer: Not less than fourteen crore rupees over the last three audited financial years.

query: How many vehicles must a bidder own or have access to?
anchors: not fewer than sixty vehicles
answer: At least sixty, of which at least forty must be under five years old.

query: What performance security is required and in what form?
anchors: performance security equal to five percent of the accepted contract value
answer: Five percent of the accepted contract value, as a bank guarantee, within twenty one days of the letter of acceptance.

query: What penalty applies if door to door collection is missed in a ward?
anchors: five thousand rupees per ward per day
answer: Five thousand rupees per ward per day.

query: What is the penalty for dumping waste outside the designated facility?
anchors: one lakh rupees per instance
answer: One lakh rupees per instance for unauthorised disposal outside the designated processing facility.

query: By when must sanitation worker wages be paid each month?
anchors: on or before the seventh day of the following month
answer: By bank transfer on or before the seventh day of the following month.

query: Who appoints the arbitrator if a contract dispute is not settled?
anchors: sole arbitrator appointed by the Principal Secretary
answer: A sole arbitrator appointed by the Principal Secretary, Urban Development and Housing Department, seated at Indore.

query: What is the minimum password length required?
anchors: at least fourteen characters long
answer: At least fourteen characters, checked against known breached credentials.

query: Does the company force periodic password rotation?
anchors: Passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule
answer: No. Rotation is required only on evidence or reasonable suspicion of compromise.

query: How long does a just in time administrative elevation last?
anchors: maximum of eight hours at a time
answer: A maximum of eight hours, logged with a business justification.

query: When is access revoked after an employee leaves?
anchors: revoked within four hours of the last working hour
answer: Within four hours of the last working hour, and before notification on involuntary separation.

query: Can I use an AI coding assistant on a confidential repository?
anchors: prohibited on repositories classified as Confidential or Restricted
answer: No. Approved AI coding assistants are permitted only on Internal or lower repositories.

query: How quickly must a lost laptop be reported?
anchors: within two hours of discovery
answer: To the security operations centre within two hours of discovery, at any hour.

query: What are the response deadlines for a severity one incident?
anchors: incident commander to be appointed within fifteen minutes
answer: An incident commander within fifteen minutes and executive notification within thirty minutes.

query: How often must a vendor handling confidential data be reassessed?
anchors: re-assessed every two years
answer: Every two years, with a security assessment before contract signature.

query: What happens if an employee fails three simulated phishing tests?
anchors: three consecutive simulated phishing exercises is enrolled in mandatory additional training
answer: They are enrolled in mandatory additional training.

query: How is an unlabelled document classified by default?
anchors: unlabelled artefact is treated as Confidential by default
answer: As Confidential.
